rationale: Price is sitting essentially at the session low (0% of range) with the last five 1-minute candles showing a tight, low-momentum drift downward on mixed volume — no clear capitulation spike or reversal signal to support a long, and no clean breakdown impulse with momentum to support a short. The broad market is under significant pressure (SPY -3.14%, VIXY +8.79%), which adds macro tail risk to any directional bet, and with 86 minutes to close and a small daily loss already on the books, the risk/reward of forcing a trade at an ambiguous level near the low does not justify entry.
